title: Injectivity from source-fibre differential formula
statement: Let k be a field, f:Y -> Spec k smooth, c:B -> Spec k, U an open of Y, z a point of U, K=kappa_U(z), T a scheme, and h:T -> Spec K and g:T -> B times_k Y satisfy the source-point factorization. Let A=Gamma(T,O_T) and p:B times_k Y -> B. If an A-linear map D:A tensor_K bertiniCotangentFibre(f,U,z) -> Gamma(T,g^*Omega_p) satisfies, for every source open W containing U.ι(z), every a in Gamma(Y,W), every b in A, and every proof hV that g maps T into the inverse image of W, the formula sending b tensor the differential component of bertiniLocalFirstJet(f,U,z,W,a) to b times the restriction to T of g^*(d(pr_Y^*a)), then D is injective. [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf, lem-zl-bertini-local-first-jets].

proof.text: The relative differential stalk equivalence identifies differential germs with Kaehler generators. Every stalk element of U is represented by a germ on Y because the open immersion induces a stalk isomorphism. Thus the second components of source-local first jets span the cotangent fibre, after extending scalars to the residue field.

For each K-linear functional l on the cotangent fibre, extend it to an A-linear functional L on the pulled-back relative differential sections with the prescribed value on each source-local differential.

The formula for D with coefficient 1 shows that L composed with D agrees with the scalar extension of l on the spanning differential germs. The linear-map scalar-extension adjunction and equality on a spanning set make the two A-linear maps equal.

If D(t)=0, every scalar-extended functional annihilates t. Choose any vector-space basis of the cotangent fibre. Its base-changed basis has coordinates given by the scalar-extended coordinate functionals, so all coordinates of t vanish and t=0. This includes an empty basis and the zero ring of sections.
